en.headline: CHP warns influenza may stay active as school year begins
en.dek: Eleven severe paediatric flu cases have been recorded since late June, including one death; the centre expects outbreaks may occur after students return.
body: The Centre for Health Protection on Sunday reminded schools and parents to take steps against communicable diseases as students return for the new school year, saying Hong Kong remains in the influenza season that began in late June.

The CHP said 11 severe paediatric influenza cases have been recorded so far this season. Eight of the children have been discharged, two remain in critical condition and one case was fatal. Surveillance data still show high influenza activity after widespread community transmission in recent months, and the centre said outbreaks may occur in schools at the start of term.

CHP Controller Dr Edwin Tsui said a letter had been sent through the Education Bureau to all schools. He urged schools and parents to join the 2026/27 Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach Programme and to use the new electronic consent form on the eHealth app. Families whose schools are not in the outreach scheme were told to arrange vaccination at private clinics in the Vaccination Subsidy Scheme once the 2026/27 programme begins.

Covid-19 activity rose from June and eased after an early-August peak, with two severe paediatric Covid-19 cases recorded since June, neither child vaccinated against Covid-19. RSV activity has edged up but remains below recent peaks. The CHP said students and staff with even mild respiratory symptoms should wear a surgical mask, stay away from school or work, and seek medical advice.

zh.headline: 防護中心料開學初期流感仍活躍 籲學校家長防疫
zh.dek: 今季自6月底起已錄11宗兒童流感嚴重個案，包括一宗死亡；中心料想新學年學校或現爆發。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心周日提醒學校及家長，新學年學生回校，須採取措施預防傳染病在校園傳播。中心指本港自6月底進入流感季節，目前仍處於流感季節。
中心表示，今季至今錄得11宗兒童流感嚴重個案，其中8人已康復出院、2人情況危殆、1人死亡。最新監測顯示流感活躍程度仍處高水平，近月社區傳播廣泛，感染及嚴重個案隨之上升，開學初期流感料持續活躍，學校亦可能出現爆發。
中心總監徐樂堅表示，已透過教育局去信全港學校。他呼籲學校及家長參與2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗學校外展計劃，並盡早經醫健通流動應用程式提交新推出的電子同意書。若學校沒有參加外展計劃，家長應在新一年度疫苗接種計劃展開後，盡快帶子女到參與疫苗資助計劃的私家診所接種。
新冠病毒活躍程度自6月上升，8月初見頂後回落；6月至今錄得兩宗兒童新冠嚴重個案，兩名兒童均未接種新冠疫苗。呼吸道合胞病毒活躍程度近期輕微上升，但仍低於近年高峰。中心提醒，師生即使只有輕微呼吸道病徵，亦應戴外科口罩、停課或停工並盡快求醫。
